world.h: Sudan's famine risk worsens, monitor warns
world.b: Conflict and El Niño-linked drought are worsening food insecurity across Darfur and Kordofan, including areas at risk of famine, the IPC food crisis monitor said.
world.title: Sudan's famine risk worsened by conflict, drought and funding shortages, report says

world.h: NATO commander: alliance 'ready to fight tonight'
world.b: NATO's top military commander said the alliance is ready to fight if attacked, as European officials warn Russia could test its defenses with covert attacks or a limited incursion.

world.h: Zelenskyy: Russia still hitting energy sites
world.b: Zelenskyy said Russia kept striking Ukraine's energy facilities after Trump announced an energy ceasefire. He said Ukraine would honor such a deal if Moscow did the same.

world.h: Saudis down more Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh
world.b: Saudi Arabia shot down more Houthi missiles as Riyadh was targeted again, according to Al Jazeera's live coverage of the regional war.
world.title: Saudi Arabia shoots down more Houthi missiles as Riyadh targeted again

world.h: Iran targets US-backed oil shuttle in Hormuz
world.b: Iran signalled it intends to disrupt an Arab-operated, US-assisted shuttle system that has moved more energy exports through the Strait of Hormuz during the war.

national.h: Erie mass shooting gunman and victims named
national.b: The Erie County coroner named Matthew Stone Sr., 45, as the gunman who killed eight people, including seven relatives, at a Pennsylvania home Friday before taking his own life.
national.title: Authorities name the gunman and most of the 8 victims in last week's Erie mass shooting

national.h: Help for Christa Pike delayed after failed execution
national.b: 911 recordings show about half an hour passed before Tennessee prison officials confirmed an emergency call from the execution chamber after Christa Pike's failed lethal injection, the AP reports.
national.title: Emergency help for Christa Pike was delayed by confusion after failed execution, 911 calls reveal

national.h: Judge orders Trump to cancel taxpayer-funded TV ads
national.b: A federal judge in New York ordered the administration to cancel remaining TV ads paid for with taxpayer money to promote Trump's political message, siding with Common Cause and others.

politics.h: Musk is biggest known midterm donor
politics.b: Elon Musk has given more than $276 million since July to try to save Republican majorities in Congress, including $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, his super PAC confirmed.

politics.h: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
politics.b: Homeland Security Investigations agents searched the Minnesota Democrat's home as part of a criminal investigation, the AP reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. Details were not immediately clear.

international.h: UK blames Iran for RAF airbase plot
international.b: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said a suspected plot targeting RAF Fairford was "almost certainly" directed by Iran's Revolutionary Guard. Britain sanctioned two Iranian nationals; Tehran denies involvement.
international.title: UK blames Iran for airbase plot, sanctions two Iranian nationals

international.h: Ethiopian forces enter Tigray town of Adwa
international.b: Federal forces and an allied militia entered Adwa without a fight, residents said, a day after Tigray People's Liberation Front fighters withdrew.
international.title: Ethiopian forces enter strategic Tigray town of Adwa, witnesses say

international.h: Stolen Renoirs found behind wall in France
international.b: Two Renoir paintings stolen from a French museum last month were found damaged behind a false wall after six arrests, prosecutors said, ahead of a planned second heist.

international.h: Explosion in northern Israel kills teen on school trip
international.b: A 15-year-old on a school trip was killed and 19 others were injured in an explosion near the Lebanese border, officials said. The cause is under investigation.

business.b: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel in economics for models that help governments and central banks manage shocks like energy crises and inflation.
business.title: WATCH: 2 American economists win Nobel for studying how to deal with economic shocks

business.h: Big bank earnings to show Fed hike's impact
business.b: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citigroup report third-quarter results Tuesday, offering a first look at how the Fed's rate hike is working through the economy.
business.title: Bank earnings this week could offer clues to impact of Fed's rate hike

sports.h: UCLA QB Iamaleava likely out for season
sports.b: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava is expected to miss the rest of the season with a knee injury suffered in Saturday's 17-15 win over Oregon, CBS Sports reports.
sports.title: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava expected to miss remainder of season after knee injury

sports.h: LSU's latest loss puts Kiffin on the spot
sports.b: Lane Kiffin harped on officiating after LSU's second loss in six games, but CBS Sports says questionable late-game decisions start with the coach.

sports.h: No NFC East team wins in Week 5
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 5 grades give the Patriots and Packers an 'A+', while all four NFC East teams went winless, including the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers.

sports.h: Commanders, Giants tie 27-27 after OT meltdown
sports.b: Washington ran out of time at the end of overtime with no timeouts, leaving the NFL's first tie of the season after Jayden Daniels went down with eight seconds left.

sports.h: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans
sports.b: Houston sent a 2027 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth-rounder to Arizona for the 24-year-old receiver and a 2027 seventh-round pick.

sports.h: Eagles' Sirianni takes blame for London loss
sports.b: The Eagles lost their third straight, 19-17 to the Jaguars in London, after a controversial decision with eight seconds left. Coach Nick Sirianni accepted the blame.
Oregon committed seven turnovers in a 17-15 loss to UCLA, earning an 'F' on CBS Sports' Week 6 report card for contenders. Ohio State got a 'C+'.

sports.h: Georgia still SEC's king after Week 6
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 6 overreactions: Kirby Smart's Georgia silenced Bryant-Denny Stadium, and Saturday delivered dramatic upsets and a shifted Big Ten hierarchy.

local.b: Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a disaster emergency over the spread of measles in New York.
local.title: NY measles spread prompts 'disaster' emergency. It didn't have to be this way, health commissioner says.

local.h: Man shot by ICE still has bullet in neck
local.b: The man shot by ICE agents in New York City last week remained in solitary confinement at a Brooklyn federal lockup with a bullet lodged in his neck, his attorneys said.
local.title: Man shot by ICE in NYC still has bullet lodged in neck, attorneys say

local.h: Mamdani orders review of NYPD force policies
local.b: Facing criticism from the left over his approach to policing, Mayor Mamdani announced a comprehensive review of the NYPD's use of force policies.
local.title: Mayor Mamdani orders review of NYPD use of force policies

local.h: NYPD Bomb Squad contractor faced LI scrutiny
local.b: A company that won a $23 million contract to build an NYPD Bomb Squad building in the Bronx was flagged in a 2020 Nassau County inspector general report for not disclosing who ran the business.
local.title: Company that won $23M NYPD building contract was investigated by LI watchdog

periods.text: Patchy fog after 5am.  Otherwise, partly cloudy, with a low around 61. Northwest wind 5 to 9 mph becoming light west  after midnight.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Patchy fog before 11am.  Otherwise, mostly sunny, with a high near 72. Light southeast wind becoming south 6 to 11 mph in the morning.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 69. South wind 11 to 13 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday
periods.text: Increasing clouds, with a high near 77. West wind around 11 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 61. North wind 9 to 11 mph.

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: Sunny, with a steady temperature around 63.
